source: Curated from WHO SARS-CoV-2 variant tracking (data.who.int/dashboards/covid19/variants) and documented WHO Variants of Concern designations. Dominance windows are approximate global estimates.
units: dominantFrom/dominantUntil define the approximate window during which a variant was the globally dominant lineage. Variants with no dominantFrom (Beta, Gamma, BA.2.86) circulated but never became the dominant global lineage; they are listed as circulating in the UI.

variants.name: Ancestral
variants.note: Original SARS-CoV-2 first detected in Wuhan, China. WHO alerted to pneumonia cases of unknown cause on 31 December 2019.

variants.name: Alpha
variants.note: Designated a VOC by WHO on 18 December 2020.

variants.name: Beta
variants.note: Designated a VOC on 18 December 2020. Regionally dominant in South Africa but not globally.

variants.name: Gamma
variants.note: Designated a VOC on 11 January 2021. Dominant in Brazil and parts of South America.

variants.name: Delta
variants.note: Designated a VOC on 11 May 2021. Became the globally dominant variant mid-2021.

variants.name: Omicron BA.1
variants.note: Designated a VOC on 26 November 2021, hours after first samples were shared from South Africa and Botswana.

variants.name: Omicron BA.2
variants.note: Stealth sublineage; replaced BA.1 as the dominant lineage in early 2022.

variants.name: Omicron BA.4/BA.5
variants.note: First documented in South Africa in January 2022; drove the second half of 2022.

variants.name: Omicron XBB
variants.note: Recombinant of BA.2 sublineages, first observed in Singapore in August 2022.

variants.name: Omicron XBB.1.5
variants.note: Kraken; designated a VOI in January 2023.

variants.name: Omicron EG.5
variants.note: Eris; designated a VOI on 9 August 2023.

variants.name: Omicron BA.2.86
variants.note: Pirola; highly divergent from BA.2. Designated a VOI on 21 November 2023. Never became the globally dominant lineage.

variants.name: Omicron JN.1
variants.note: First documented on 25 August 2023; designated a VOI on 18 December 2023 and became the dominant lineage worldwide in late 2023.
